newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX SKIPPER BLIND OUT FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER GROIN OP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX SKIPPER BLIND OUT FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER GROIN OP.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam captain Danny Blind will have a groin operation on Friday that will keep him out of action until the New Year, Dutch ANP news agency said on Thursday.

The former international will go into hospital in Amsterdam for surgery on a build-up of calcium in his groin. He is expected to miss at least three months. The 35-year-old central defender's contract with Ajax expires at the end of this season.

Blind's operation adds to the Dutch champions' woes. Struggling in the domestic league and stumbling in the European Cup's Champions league, the club has a star-studded injury list, including teenaged striker Patrick Kluivert.
Earlier on Thursday, coach Louis van Gaal announced that he would leave the club at the end of the season.
